_doc: Oathwild classes = MASTERIES. BUILT by tools/build-trees.mjs from tools/trees/<class>.mjs (edit those, then run it) — the tree rules (owner 2026-11-26) are at the top of tools/trees/_dsl.mjs: no paths or subclasses, several choices at every class level, every node ONE rank (a spell's rank II / III is its own node that `needs` the rank before), one training node per weapon and armour kind, big passives only (no small percentages except critical chance), few defensive abilities and heals, every ability an area (nova, cone, line, ground circle, leap, charge) — no plain projectiles except wand basics, plain common names. Every character level-up picks a class (js/rules/levels.js); a class level gives its growth and `rules.pointsPerLevel` points to spend in that class. Node kinds: spell (rank 1, or `rank` 2/3 on a rank node), passive (`mods`, js/rules/sheet.js vocabulary), prof (`grants`: one training, js/rules/proficiency.js), mod (`on` = a spell node of this class; `change` = { mult, add, set }). `needs`: node ids owned first. `free`: comes with the class level. `choice`: nodes sharing it exclude each other (capstones). Spells learned from a class get +`classPowerPerLevel` per class level above 1 of that class. `tier`: base (open at creation), advanced (unlocked, 10 levels) or specialty (prestige: unlocked by requirements, 5 levels). `round: 2` = written but not offered yet.

rules._starterDoc: `starter` on a base class: Emberveil base keys a new character of that class starts wearing (normal, medium quality, item level 1).
rules._dualDoc: `dualWield: true` on a class: its characters may hold a second one-handed weapon in the off hand (game-standards §5b — which classes may is data). The Two-Weapon Fighting talent grants it to anyone. The off-hand weapon strikes right after each main-hand swing for Farhold's OFFHAND_DAMAGE share of its own dice (js/rules/combat.js).

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.blurb: Steel, nerve and a shield or a great blade. The toughest body in the party.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.blurb: Long shots, quick feet and traps laid where the enemy will walk.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.blurb: Strikes from where you aren't looking, poison on every edge.

mage.name: Mage
mage.blurb: Fireballs that blow enemies off their feet, ice that bursts from the ground, lightning from the sky. Fragile, and devastating from range.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.blurb: A mace and the light: lances of sun, pillars that slam down from the sky, a holy blast that flattens what is round you. One heal, one revive.

druid.name: Druid
druid.blurb: Becomes the wolf, the bear or the mountain cat, calls wolves to the fight, and throws thorns and tornadoes.

bard.name: Bard
bard.blurb: Blasts of sound that knock crowds flat, a lullaby for the ones left standing, and a song that lifts the party.

shaman.name: Shaman
shaman.blurb: A hammer that cracks with lightning, thunder that throws crowds off their feet, lava underfoot and a spirit bear.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.blurb: Sworn steel and holy light. The class that opens plate armour.

spellblade.name: Spellblade
spellblade.blurb: A blade in one hand and a spell in the other — every strike carries magic.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.blurb: Bargained power: hexes that rot, a bound fiend, and gates you pay for in blood.

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer
wayfarer.blurb: Bare hands, a staff and a still mind. Fast, hard to hit, no armour needed.

pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
pyromancer.blurb: Everything burns. Lines of fire, falling stones and flashovers.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.blurb: Bolts that fork from foe to foe and a storm you walk inside.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.blurb: Raises the dead to fight for you, or rots the living where they stand.

witch_hunter.name: Witch Hunter
witch_hunter.blurb: Silver, iron nets and holy writs for the things that cast and the things that crawl out of rifts.

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.blurb: A specialty class: flourishes, lunges and a showman's flurry for a light blade.

shadowdancer.name: Shadowdancer
shadowdancer.blurb: A specialty class: steps through shadow and leaves shades of itself behind.

spellfletcher.name: Spellfletcher
spellfletcher.blurb: A specialty class: every arrow carries a spell — frost, flame or raw force.

bladesworn.name: Bladesworn
bladesworn.blurb: A specialty class: years with one weapon — its every swing perfected.

wrathborn.name: Wrathborn
wrathborn.blurb: A specialty class: fury that shrugs off wounds and swings wider the more it bleeds.

gravecutter.name: Gravecutter
gravecutter.blurb: A specialty class: contracts, marks and the one cut that ends it. Found through a contract in the wilds.

dragon_knight.name: Dragon Knight
dragon_knight.blurb: Fire-tempered steel, scales and a wyrm's breath. (Opens after the level cap rises.)

chronomancer.name: Chronomancer
chronomancer.blurb: Hurries friends, slows foes, and stops the clock. (Opens after the level cap rises.)

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.blurb: Sees the blow before it lands. (Opens after the level cap rises.)

tinker.name: Tinker
tinker.blurb: Sentries, grenades and lucky finds from every pocket. (Opens with the Smithing bench.)

starcaller.name: Starcaller
starcaller.blurb: Star darts, falling stars and a blade of starlight. (Opens after the level cap rises.)
